unprofiled_baseline.scope: Existing framework-turn-bench.py fixture; one warmup and three distinct measured branches per mode. Complete HTTP wall time includes checkpoints and decoding. This is a baseline refresh, not a speedup comparison.
unprofiled_baseline.replay: All six measured messages, request hashes, finish reasons and prompt/output/cache counts match the prior retained DPP candidate; the cold-prefix message hash also matches.

profile.scope: Separate instrumented HTTP server at capacity 196608: cold coding/tool history, then the greedy warmup branch. The target chunk runs from its EmbedKernel to the next predictor EmbedKernel. Loading, checkpoint capture, predictor catch-up and generation are excluded from the chunk totals.

experiments.name: Dense prefill row-group locality
experiments.mechanism: Use the existing DenseF16GEMMKernel row-group template to group 2/4/8 output-row tiles, preserving each dot product's K order. Four rotating weight buffers exceed MALL capacity.
experiments.decision: Rejected: only small/inconsistent early timing gains, and the standalone run did not complete its independent quality gate. No production dispatch was changed.
experiments.quality: Completed 16384x2560 and 13312x2560 cases at 2048/2049 tokens retain original projection bytes and guards. The unchanged 2560x6144 baseline control then fails the standalone FP64 absolute-error gate: 0.0023353505 versus 0.002. The gate was not relaxed; this is not a qualified full sweep.

experiments.name: 2176-token prefill capacity
experiments.mechanism: Change only kPrefillChunkTokens from 2048 to 2176, aiming to fold a short appended tail into one chunk.
experiments.decision: Rejected at the existing full-logit quality gate before candidate HTTP timing or deeper-context expansion.
